problems: AIC National Homicide Monitoring Program reports (aic.gov.au) refused all connections from this environment (HTTP/2 stream reset / empty reply), so NHMP jurisdiction tables were not obtained. Victoria Crime Statistics Agency (LGA homicide tables) returned HTTP 403. LGA names were matched to ABS 2022 LGAs by name within state; older NSW/QLD LGAs that were later merged would not appear separately (none left unmatched besides those listed). Queensland also publishes the same offences by police region/district/division monthly (data.qld.gov.au) - not added.
